parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS client_id, c.bedrijfsnaam, c.owner_voornaam, c.owner_e164, c.slug, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.started_at::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS calls_taken, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ev.event_type = 'call.missed' AND ev.occurred_at::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missed_recovered, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bookings, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.received_at::date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviews FROM clients c LEFT JOIN calls ca ON ca.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN events ev ON ev.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.client_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.daily_stats_sms_enabled = true AND c.onboarding_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.onboarding_completed_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY c.id, c.bedrijfsnaam, c.owner_voornaam, c.owner_e164, c.slug;

SELECT $1::uuid AS client_id, $2 AS bedrijfsnaam, $3 AS owner_voornaam, $4 AS owner_e164, $5 AS slug, $6::int AS calls_taken, $7::int AS missed_recovered, $8::int AS bookings, $9::int AS reviews, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list WHERE e164_hash = encode(digest($4, 'sha256'), 'hex')) AS suppressed;

meta.notes: Daily stats SMS only for clients in first 14 days post-go-live (per onboarding playbook). After D14 weekly email takes over.
